summary: The pull request page counts the review threads you have not read, and Comments marks them for that visit.

new.title: Unread review threads
new.copy: The line at the top of the pull request page now ends with a count of unread threads, after the open threads and the ones that need you.

features.title: Welcome to Goodboy
features.copy: Four short steps take you from install to a first agent reading your code.

features.title: Your agents
features.copy: Goodboy runs the coding agents already on this Mac, and one ready agent is enough.

features.title: Your first workspace
features.copy: A workspace is what you work on: one repository, or a folder that holds several.

features.title: Home
features.copy: A window with no workspace open shows Home, which lists your workspaces with their folder count and where their folders live.

features.title: One page per provider
features.copy: Each provider has its own page in Providers and models with its usage, the models shown in the picker, its permissions and your account.

features.title: Update the provider CLI
features.copy: When a model needs a newer provider CLI, the provider page says so and one button installs it.

features.title: Permissions for each provider
features.copy: See which permission modes a provider can honor before you pick one, from Read only to Full access.

features.title: Integrations
features.copy: Connect GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Linear, Jira, Sentry and Slack from one page, and see the account behind each.

features.title: About you
features.copy: Tell agents once who you are and how you like to work, in four short fields.

features.title: Settings
features.copy: Settings opens from the foot of the sidebar or with ⌘,, on the page you used last.

features.title: Supported tools
features.copy: Connect GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Jira, Linear, Sentry and Slack in Settings › Integrations.

features.title: Agents use your tools
features.copy: Agents on any provider can read and act on the tools you connected, without holding your keys.

features.title: Tasks
features.copy: Work from one list instead of seven tabs.

features.title: Find any issue by code or link
features.copy: Paste HBL-412, #318 or a link in the search box and open the issue, even when it is not assigned to you.

features.title: Starred issues
features.copy: Star an issue from the star next to its key in the pane, or press s on its row, to keep it in the Starred group on top of Tasks.

features.title: Start from any item
features.copy: Press Start session on an issue or an error, or Start from HBL-412 from the row's menu.

features.title: Link an item to a session
features.copy: Attach a task to work that already exists with Link to a session, under the properties of the item, or use Link work (or L) in a session's Overview header.

features.title: Trackers
features.copy: Read Sentry errors with stack trace, breadcrumbs and tags inside Goodboy, and filter them by project.

features.title: Code hosts
features.copy: Work on GitHub pull requests and issues, GitLab merge requests, and Bitbucket comments, approvals and merges without leaving Goodboy.

features.title: Slack: what agents can do
features.copy: Decide how far agents go in Slack.

features.title: Reply ready for #channel
features.copy: Approve what goes out in Slack from where you already are.

features.title: Slack signature
features.copy: Let people in a thread see when an agent wrote a reply.

features.title: Images from your tools
features.copy: See screenshots attached in Linear, Jira and GitHub inside Goodboy.

features.title: Records read the same way
features.copy: Read items from any tool the same way.

features.title: Comment threads
features.copy: Follow replies under the comment they answer, in Linear and GitLab, and fold long threads behind Show earlier replies.

features.title: Start a run
features.copy: Write what you want done and press Start.

features.title: Order | If
features.copy: Goodboy starts

features.title: 1     | You said it: ~Fix a layout or @Scout, or a default you set in Settings
features.copy: That preset, or that role at once. A session default wins over the workspace one.

features.title: 2     | The ask names a preset of the workspace, or shares at least two words of its description and step titles
features.copy: A Preset workflow that adapts as it goes. A name match ranks first, then the preset last used in the session.

features.title: 3     | A task is linked, or the ask is a list or names many places ("every page")
features.copy: An Orchestrated workflow

features.title: 4     | The session's open pull request fails its checks or has changes requested, and the ask is about it
features.copy: An Auto agent

features.title: 5     | A question, a check or one file
features.copy: An Auto agent

features.title: 6     | Nothing above
features.copy: An Auto agent first

features.title: One start form
features.copy: Every door draws the same form: the New session page, a session's Runs page (and so the New menu's Start a run), ⌘K, and the setup Scout run.

features.title: The Kind chip
features.copy: Every run started from the field or the New session page leads its settings line with a Kind chip that names what runs.

features.title: The model of a run
features.copy: The settings line of a run names the model that runs it, next to the Kind chip.

features.title: The New session page
features.copy: Start a session from your goal: write it or pick an issue, then choose the kind of run.

features.title: Start on a task
features.copy: Start a session from an issue in Tasks, with the issue linked and its goal written in.

features.title: Review a pull request
features.copy: A pull request waiting on you in Tasks shows Review pull request in place of Start.

features.title: Start more work in a session
features.copy: New in a session opens a menu: Start a run, Write a report and Draw a wireframe.

features.title: Tool
features.copy: Key

features.title: Ask
features.copy: ⌘L

features.title: Start blank
features.copy: Start from the goal instead.

features.title: Named by Goodboy
features.copy: Get a short title without writing one.

features.title: Star an issue from Link work
features.copy: Link work links a task to the session only.

features.title: Undo an unlink
features.copy: Unlinking a task from a session acts at once, with a 10-second Undo toast, and ⌘Z works too.

features.title: Move an issue between the session and a branch
features.copy: Choose where an issue belongs with Move to in its chip menu: the session or one of the open branches of its project.

features.title: Session overview
features.copy: Read a session as one page: the goal, what needs you, what runs and where each branch stands.

features.title: Refresh a session
features.copy: Pull requests opened outside Goodboy, by an agent or from a terminal, show up when a turn ends or when you come back to the window.

features.title: Full log
features.copy: Follow what happened in a session in one list.

features.title: Cards
features.copy: See what needs you, what runs, what is next, where each branch stands and what finished.

features.title: Next
features.copy: Know the moves that unblock the task, such as answering a question, fixing a failing check or opening a pull request.

features.title: Group
features.copy: Holds

features.title: Decide
features.copy: a plan waits on your OK, a question

features.title: Fix
features.copy: a stuck agent, a failing check, review conversations

features.title: Update
features.copy: branches behind or diverged

features.title: Ship
features.copy: push, open a pull request, mark ready, merge, move the tracker item, clean up, and last Archive this session

features.title: Time left
features.copy: See how long a step has left, estimated from your own past runs.

features.title: Changes
features.copy: See and undo what agents changed in a session without a branch.

features.title: Stage board
features.copy: See where each task stands without moving cards around.

features.title: List view
features.copy: Scan every session in one table.

features.title: Done and Archived lanes
features.copy: Finished work stays in view.

features.title: Session card
features.copy: Read a task at a glance: its title on two lines, its project in gray, and one signal at the right.

features.title: Bulk select
features.copy: Tidy many sessions at once.

features.title: Session list
features.copy: The left column lists the sessions of the workspace, one line each.

features.title: Pin a session to keep it at the top
features.copy: Keep the sessions you return to at the top of the list.

features.title: Now chip
features.copy: Know what runs from any screen.

features.title: Notifications
features.copy: Catch up in one place.

features.title: Open in new window
features.copy: Give each workspace its own window, so switching does not interrupt running agents.

groups.title: Review and resolve on the Branch page

features.title: Resolve
features.copy: Turn review comments into commits without writing the fixes yourself.

features.title: Bulk actions
features.copy: Handle many comments at once.

features.title: Review sources
features.copy: Read pull request comments and your own notes in one list in the Comments section.

features.title: Comment states
features.copy: See what each comment needs next.

features.title: Failed drafts
features.copy: When a fix fails, the comment says why in one sentence and links to the agent's transcript.

features.title: See what a resolve did
features.copy: Open a fix run from Activity or from a comment to see what the agent did.

features.title: Hints when a fix starts
features.copy: Tell the agent what to weigh before a fix starts.

features.title: Fixes already on the branch
features.copy: Goodboy checks origin before it pushes.

features.title: A fix that went missing
features.copy: If a fix commit is no longer on the branch, for example after a squash done elsewhere, the comment reads Fix went missing.

features.title: Close on GitHub
features.copy: Finish a review with Push N fixes in the Branch header.

features.title: Review replies in your voice
features.copy: Choose the tone of the replies the agent drafts: Terse, Friendly, Formal or Your replies, which learns from your last 20 review replies.

features.title: Fixes on a branch that moved
features.copy: Accept a fix even after the branch got new commits.

features.title: Squash and fold the resolve commits
features.copy: Tidy the fix commits before reviewers see them, in the Commits section.

features.title: Notes before a pull request
features.copy: Review your own diff before anyone else does.

features.title: Pull request on the Branch page
features.copy: Click a worktree under Projects in a session and the session rail steps into it: the project and the branch on top, a status line with Rebase while the branch is behind, then Pull request, Comments, Files (with the lines added and removed beside the file count), Commits and Checks with their counts.

features.title: One trail to the Branch page
features.copy: Every way into a branch, from the palette, a notification, a chat card or the board, opens the same Branch page with the session rail stepped into that branch.

features.title: Write it
features.copy: Get a pull request title, description and changelog entry in your repo's format, then Goodboy pushes the branch and opens the pull request.

features.title: PR description follows the push
features.copy: A description Goodboy wrote is updated after a history push, so it keeps matching the branch.

features.title: Read the code
features.copy: Read the branch against its base in Files, unified or split.

features.title: Write review
features.copy: Review someone else's pull request from its diff.

features.title: Shape the history
features.copy: Clean up a branch by hand in the Commits section.

features.title: Safe edits
features.copy: Undo and Redo, also ⌘Z and ⌘⇧Z, restore edits while the Commits page stays open.

features.title: Conflicting edits
features.copy: A conflicting edit names the file and leaves the branch as it was.

features.title: Conflicts merged in a copy
features.copy: When a step stops on a conflict, the notice names the step and the file, and your branch is untouched.

features.title: Push with lease and restore
features.copy: Force push updates the online branch separately after a local edit.

features.title: Backups
features.copy: Under the graph, Previous versions N opens the older histories of the branch with when and why each was saved.

features.title: Suggest a message
features.copy: Get a commit message drafted for a reword.

features.title: Bring them into the plan
features.copy: If someone pushed after you applied, Goodboy lists their new commits and offers to add them to the plan and push again.

features.title: Rebase on main
features.copy: Rebase on the worktree status line (6 behind main) moves the branch onto the latest main with git alone.

features.title: Chip
features.copy: Means

features.title: Rebasing
features.copy: a breathing chip, with the replay step in its tooltip

features.title: Queued
features.copy: a quiet chip

features.title: no chip
features.copy: the branch is rebased

features.title: Conflict
features.copy: the branch waits for Auto

features.title: Auto resolving
features.copy: a breathing chip while Auto works on it, with the file in its tooltip

features.title: Rebased by Auto
features.copy: shown until every branch Auto took is clean, and then nothing

features.title: Failed
features.copy: the cause is in its tooltip

features.title: After a pull request merges
features.copy: Decide what happens to a merged branch: Ask first, Delete on this Mac or Also on origin, per workspace or project, with 14 days to restore it.

features.title: Start a workflow
features.copy: A workflow run starts from the New session page: pick Orchestrated or Preset, and press Start workflow.

features.title: Orchestrated
features.copy: Give a goal and a model picks each next step, with its role, model, effort and a reason.

features.title: A preset as the plan a run starts from
features.copy: A run started from a preset in Start a run follows that preset as a plan, and the line under its title says "Workflow · Preset Fix a layout · Adapt as it goes · 1 change".

features.title: Preset and Custom
features.copy: A preset is a ready sequence of steps, each with its role and model, kept in the Workflows studio.

features.title: Built-in workflows
features.copy: Start from Refactor, Plan and ship or Fix a bug.

features.title: Runs of a workflow
features.copy: The Workflows list is one grid: name, Built in or Edited in gray, the roles of its steps in gray ("Scout, Implementer +1"), the step count, when it last ran, and a link with its run count ("3 runs", "No runs").

features.title: Saved steps
features.copy: Reuse steps across workflows.

features.title: Model per step
features.copy: Put a light model on a scout and a strong one on the planner.

features.title: Asks you
features.copy: Choose how often a run stops for you: Every step, After the plan to approve once and then run on, or Never.

features.title: Pause, resume and skip
features.copy: Pause lets the step in flight finish and starts nothing new, even after a restart, and Resume picks up from there.

features.title: Run defaults
features.copy: Set what every new run starts with in the Run defaults tab.

features.title: Limit
features.copy: Cap what a run or a session can spend, and choose Pause workflows or Warn only.

features.title: Workflow run

features.title: Hints to the orchestrator
features.copy: Every hint is a round node on the run's line, like a step, and the line runs through it and its images without a break.

features.title: Why each step, and the run recap
features.copy: See why each step was picked.

features.title: Step handoff summary
features.copy: Each step starts from a short brief instead of the whole previous chat.

features.title: Open questions
features.copy: Each question arrives as one card with who asks, whether it is Blocking, and numbered answers with the recommended one tagged.

features.title: Let an agent decide
features.copy: Hand a question to another agent with a hint and a model from Let an agent decide, then press Hand off.

features.title: Import workflows
features.copy: Bring custom workflows over from your other workspaces with Import in the Workflows studio.

features.title: Workspace chat
features.copy: Ask about the workspace without starting a session.

features.title: Ask in a session
features.copy: Ask what is happening in a session without leaving it.

features.title: Images in chat

features.title: Roles

features.title: Agent header

features.title: What the agent received

features.title: Message and document fields

features.title: Turn footer

features.title: Tool call states

features.title: Composer plus menu
features.copy: Do more from the message box.

features.copy: Read the plan without leaving the planner.

features.title: Who receives what

features.title: Checks
features.copy: Lists CI checks in four groups: Failing, Running, Passed and Skipped. Each group has its count, with no summary line. Rest on a row to see its name, the result and the time it took, with a footnote saying where the click leads. Analyze on a failing row asks the Debugger why it failed. The row opens its drawer and reads Analyzing, Fix proposed, Fixing, Not pushed or Re-running. Start fix and Push are in the Debugger drawer. It leads with the outcome line, then the steps, Finding and Proposed fix, and one model line beside Start fix. The Checks property, readiness, the activity row and the worktree entry read one word: 2 failing, 1 running or 5 passed.
